stage.note: Vultr was bootstrapped and profitable for ~10 years before its first disclosed priced equity round in 2024 (reported by WSJ as a $333M raise at a $3.5B valuation); no prior seed/Series A/B labels are public, so this is mapped to the closest stage label (first priced external equity round) rather than a confirmed 'Series A' designation. The 2025 $329M is credit/debt financing, not equity, and is excluded from the stage/round classification.

total_funding_usd.basis: Sum of the one disclosed priced equity round (2024, $333M); the separate 2025 $329M is debt/credit financing, not equity funding, per Wikipedia citing company/press sources.

note: Vultr (legal entity The Constant Company, LLC, formerly Choopa) was founded in 2014 by David Aninowsky and was bootstrapped/profitable for roughly a decade before taking its first disclosed outside equity investment ($333M from AMD and LuminArx Capital Management in 2024, reportedly valuing it at $3.5B per WSJ). In 2025 it separately secured $329M in debt/credit financing from Bank of America, Citi, and Goldman Sachs to fund AI infrastructure build-out, including a >$1B, 50MW AMD GPU cluster in Ohio. This card covers Vultr's Windows Server Cloud Compute VM offering, part of the same company.
